provenance_note: This repository was installed into a throwaway Kiro Crew home and enabled. The page talked to capture/stub_bff.mjs, a local stand-in for the Kiro review service that serves made-up reviews of a made-up shop. No review was sent to the real service.
data_notes: The reviews, findings and diffs come from capture/stub_bff.mjs; times are relative to the moment of capture.
